senses.gloss:
ण [There are hardly any words in real use in Sanskrit beginning
 with ण. Many roots which, in the Dhātupāṭha., are written with an
 initial ण really begin with न. They are so written to show that
 the न is liable to be changed to ण when preceded by prepositions,
 like प्र, परि, अन्तर् &c.]
